Every Skill Card has 2 Augment Slots (slot 2 locked until Training Grounds L10 + unit L80, guild_facilities 79). Augments do not receive procedural statistics or stronger numerical tiers from rarity; straightforward Augments may use Rare-equivalent scarcity and build-defining Augments may use Epic- or Legendary-equivalent scarcity without implying automatic superiority. Each card has one fixed shop rarity at the Training Grounds by these rules (guild_facilities 76-77).
